layout.tagline: Hold the course on every sprint.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.description: Use your Kemudi username or email and password.
signIn.failed: Sign-in failed. Check your connection and try again.

signUp.title: Create an account
signUp.closed: This server does not take new sign-ups. Ask a project admin to invite you; the invitation email has a link to create your account.

accountForm.terms: Creating an account accepts this server's terms of service and privacy policy.
accountForm.failed: The account could not be created.

forgotPassword.title: Reset your password
forgotPassword.description: We will email you a link to choose a new password.
forgotPassword.sent: If an account matches {{username}}, a reset link is on its way to that account's email address.
forgotPassword.failed: The reset email was not sent. Try again.

changePassword.title: Choose a new password
changePassword.done: Your password is changed. <link>Sign in</link> with the new one.
changePassword.invalidLink: This reset link is invalid or has expired. Request a new one.

invitation.title: Invitation
invitation.notFound: This invitation was already used or has been cancelled. Ask the person who invited you to send a new one.
invitation.invitedByAdmin: A project admin invited you as {{role}}.
invitation.existingHint: Sign in to accept. The project is added to your account.
